Diabetes Prediction Project
===========================

Overview
--------
This project focuses on predicting diabetes using machine learning techniques in Python.  
The notebook includes data preprocessing, exploratory data analysis, feature scaling, and model building to classify whether a patient is diabetic or not.

Dataset
-------
- Structured dataset in CSV format  
- Contains medical and health-related features  
- Used for classification and predictive modeling  
- Preprocessing steps applied to handle missing values and feature scaling  

Models Used
-----------
- Logistic Regression  
- Decision Tree Classifier  
- Random Forest Classifier  
- Support Vector Machine (SVM)  

Tools & Technologies
--------------------
- Python  
- Pandas  
- NumPy  
- Scikit-learn  
- Matplotlib  
- Seaborn  
- Jupyter Notebook  

Workflow
--------
1. Data loading and inspection  
2. Data cleaning and preprocessing  
3. Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)  
4. Feature scaling and selection  
5. Model training and evaluation  

Project File
------------
- `Diabetes Prediction.ipynb` – main notebook containing analysis and model building
